difficulty_reason: H2: the author recalls the standard method but supplies its full controlled parahoric realization. Integral prime-to-p averaging separates centralizer and nonfixed graded Lie directions, and the mixed semisimple/unipotent action makes the required graded conjugacy operator invertible on the nonfixed part. Successive corrections must preserve the stated K_F+ conjugator and centralizer-valued Lie error through every filtration level and through the limit. These exact domain and control obligations are stronger than an unconstrained local conjugacy assertion, and the complete source construction is retained.
